## The problem

Describe what you are trying to accomplish that vectrava does not currently
support. Concrete scenarios help more than abstract capability lists.

## Proposed solution

Describe what you have in mind. If you have a specific design, share it; if not,
the problem statement is enough.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you thought about and why you set them aside, if applicable.

## Scope and threat model

vectrava is a defensive scanner. Probes test for failure modes in systems the
operator is authorized to test. If your request involves a new probe class,
briefly note the threat model: what attacker capability does it surface, and
what mitigation does it inform?
